dataSource: City and County of Denver Commercial Construction Permits (ArcGIS open data), queried live
notes: Pulled live from Denver's own ArcGIS open data feed on every search, not a static extract — coverage reflects whatever the city has published as of your search.

Matched by house number plus the first word of the street name; results may occasionally include unrelated records that happen to share both, and a street with a directional prefix (N/S/E/W) generally needs to be entered with the directional included to match.
Only commercial construction permits are searched; a residential-only property may show zero results even if it has permit history in the city's separate residential dataset.
Permit type and description are not published in a consistently labeled way in this dataset and typically appear blank; permit date and permit number are reliably populated.
summary: Denver is covered by a live query against the city's public commercial construction permits dataset, matched by address as you search.
